reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: A fictional receipt introduces shape, values and source facts as three separate gates.

scope.evidence: A complete offline receipt extraction pipeline returns a review candidate rather than authorizing payment.

contracts.evidence: Required nullable keys, schema version, strict converter, exact decimal amounts and READY_FOR_REVIEW have consistent meanings.

correctness.evidence: 15 actual tests cover the pinned converter/ChatClient APIs and strict duplicate/unknown/coercion/trailing data handling.

failure_handling.evidence: At most one format-repair call is allowed; value failures do not blindly retry; a stream is parsed only as a completed bounded candidate.

tradeoffs.evidence: Prompt formatting versus native schemas, conversion versus factual accuracy, decimal validation and source review are answered.

visual_learning.evidence: Five explicit illustrative cases step through raw text, strict conversion, domain checks and review; they are labelled not recorded Java execution.

code.evidence: examples/learning-spring-structured-output; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: AI-8-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
